email.layout.tagline: Infinytree — Artificial Handmade Plants That Last Forever
email.layout.footerNote: You are receiving this email because it relates to your interaction with Infinytree.
email.subject.orderInProgress: Your Infinytree Order is In Progress
email.subject.orderDelivered: Your Infinytree Order Has Been Delivered! 🎉
email.orderConfirmed.preview: Order #{orderNumber} confirmed — thank you for your purchase!
email.orderConfirmed.heading: Thank You for Your Order! 🌿
email.orderConfirmed.intro: Our team will review and will contact you within 48 hours (working days). Here is a summary of your purchase:
email.orderConfirmed.processingNote: Your order is being processed. You will receive updates by email as your order progresses.
email.orderConfirmed.contactPrefix: If you have any questions, reply to this email or contact us at
email.orderConfirmed.bankTransfer.note: Please include the order number as payment reference. Your order will be processed after payment is received.
email.orderInProgress.preview: Your Infinytree order #{orderNumber} is in progress
email.orderInProgress.heading: Your Order is In Progress
email.orderInProgress.body1: Our team has begun preparing your handcrafted botanical piece. Every composition is individually assembled and carefully inspected before it leaves our workshop.
email.orderInProgress.body2: We'll notify you as soon as your order has been dispatched.
email.orderInProgress.noUpdates: You will receive updates by email as your order progresses through our workshop.
email.orderShipped.heading: Your Order Has Shipped! 📦
email.orderShipped.body: Your Infinytree order is on its way. You can follow its journey using the tracking information below.
email.orderShipped.noTrackingNote: Tracking information will appear here once the carrier updates the shipment status.
email.orderDelivered.preview: Your Infinytree order #{orderNumber} has been delivered! 🎉
email.orderDelivered.heading: Your Order Has Been Delivered! 🎉
email.orderDelivered.body1: We hope your new botanical piece has arrived safely and complements your space beautifully.
email.orderDelivered.body2: Thank you for choosing Infinytree. If you have any questions about your order, we're always here to help.
email.shippingUpdate.heading: Your Order Has Shipped! 📦
email.shippingUpdate.body: Great news — your Infinytree order #{orderNumber} is on its way! Your handmade artificial plants are carefully packaged and heading to you now.
email.shippingUpdate.noTracking: Tracking information will be available in your account once the carrier updates the shipment status.
email.orderTransfer.preview: Someone wants to transfer an order to your Infinytree account
email.orderTransfer.heading: Order Transfer Request
email.orderTransfer.bodyWithEmail: {email} wants to transfer order #{orderNumber} to your Infinytree account.
email.orderTransfer.bodyWithoutEmail: Someone wants to transfer order #{orderNumber} to your Infinytree account.
email.orderTransfer.body2: Accepting this transfer will add the order to your account, giving you access to order history, returns, and support.
email.orderTransfer.ignoreNote: If you weren't expecting this transfer, you can safely ignore this email. Questions? Contact
email.welcome.heading: Welcome to Infinytree, {name}! 🌱
email.welcome.body1: We're thrilled to have you join our community of plant lovers. At Infinytree, we craft beautiful artificial plants that bring the warmth of nature into your home — without the maintenance.
email.welcome.body2: Handmade with care, each piece is designed to look as natural as the real thing, lasting forever with zero watering, zero sunlight, and zero fuss.
email.passwordReset.heading: Reset Your Password
email.passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your Infinytree account. Click the button below to create a new password:
email.passwordReset.orPaste: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
email.passwordReset.ignoreNote: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. The link will expire after 24 hours.
email.emailVerification.heading: Verify Your Email
email.emailVerification.body: Thanks for signing up! Please verify your email address to complete your registration.
email.emailVerification.codeNote: Enter this code on the verification page, or click the button above. The code will expire after 24 hours.
email.emailVerification.ignoreNote: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.
email.common.questionsAboutShipment: Questions about your shipment? Contact us at
email.subject.repInvite: {recruiter} invited you to join Infinytree's sales team
email.subject.repWelcome: Welcome to the Infinytree sales team
email.subject.repRecruitDeclined: An update on your invitation to {name}
email.rep.orPaste: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
email.repInvite.preview: {recruiter} invited you to join Infinytree as a sales representative
email.repInvite.heading: You're invited to join our sales team
email.repInvite.body: {recruiter} would like you to join Infinytree as a sales representative, selling our handmade artificial plants to businesses.
email.repInvite.review: Apply with your personal link below. We review every application, and nothing starts until we have approved it.
email.repInvite.expires: This link is personal and works until {date}.
email.repInvite.ignore: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.
email.repWelcome.preview: Your Infinytree sales portal is ready
email.repWelcome.heading: Welcome to the Infinytree sales team
email.repWelcome.body: Your application has been approved and your sales portal login is ready. There you can see your clients, commissions and payouts.
email.repWelcome.setPassword: Your login is {email}. Choose a password to sign in:
email.repWelcome.expires: This link works for 7 days. If it has expired, open the sales portal sign-in page and choose "Forgot password" to get a new one.
email.repDeclined.preview: An update on your Infinytree application
email.repDeclined.heading: Your Infinytree application
email.repDeclined.body: Thank you for your interest in joining us as a sales representative. After reviewing your application, we can't offer you a place on the team at this time.
email.repDeclined.thanks: We appreciate the time you took and wish you all the best.
email.repRecruitUpdate.approved.heading: {name} joined your team
email.repRecruitUpdate.approved.body: {name}'s application was approved and they now have access to the sales portal. You earn Level 2 commission on their clients' orders under the terms we agreed. You can follow it in the sales portal under Recruits.
email.repRecruitUpdate.declined.preview: An update on your invitation to {name}
email.repRecruitUpdate.declined.heading: An update on your invitation to {name}
email.repRecruitUpdate.declined.body: We reviewed {name}'s application and decided not to go ahead at this time. You can see where each of your invitations stands in the sales portal under Recruits.
email.repApplication.preview: {name} applied to join the sales team
email.repApplication.heading: New sales rep application: {name}
email.repApplication.body: {recruiter} invited this candidate, and they have applied. Nothing is created until you approve.
